Ekans evolves into Arbok starting at level 22..

Locations: Route 23 (5 %, Lv 44), Victory Road (5 %, Lv 44), Victory Road (5 %, Lv 46), Victory Road (5 %, Lv 44). That's all. Arbok is limited to these spots in FR/LG. See the interactive maps for the full area view.

Our take: Only situationally. Arbok is FireRed exclusive; Intimidate is nice but the stats are middling. There are better Poison options.
